patterns.note: Asymmetrical composition of large, full-bleed imagery paired with text blocks, often with images spanning the full viewport width and text contained within a narrower column.
Distinctive pairing of elegant, large serif headings with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for navigation and categories.
Alternating light (white/off-white) and dark (charcoal/black) background sections to create visual rhythm and clear content separation.
The primary navigation header sticks to the top of the viewport and subtly reduces in height after the initial hero section scrolls past.
Content sections and individual elements (images, text blocks) are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Each major content section is introduced with a large, aspirational visual (image or video) and a concise, evocative heading, focusing on different luxury experiences.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a taller, more prominent state to a compact, sticky version as the user scrolls down, maintaining navigation access. This effect is likely achieved with CSS transitions or JavaScript observing scroll position.
A full-width video hero automatically plays, creating an immersive introduction before scrolling out of view to reveal the main page content. This utilizes the 'video-hero' technique.

Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement during scrolling. This is likely implemented using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript scroll-triggering library.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with clean sans-serif body text and small, often uppercase, sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements, minimal to no visible corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks, conveying a sense of luxury and spaciousness).

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, high-quality, full-bleed photography and video creates an immediate sense of luxury and aspiration. The asymmetrical layouts within sections, combined with a clean, minimal UI, allow the stunning visuals of the destinations to take center stage, making the design feel more like an editorial spread than a typical marketing site.
